headline: Mercado Pago Introduces S&P 500 CEDEAR Trading for Argentine Digital Wallet Users
summary: Mercado Pago introduced access to S&P 500 CEDEAR certificates on its digital wallet platform in Argentina. The initiative allows local retail investors to gain US equity market exposure in local currency.
why: Mercado Pago is the financial technology arm of Latin American e-commerce giant MercadoLibre.

impacts.name: MercadoLibre
impacts.why: Expanding investment product options increases retail financial engagement across Mercado Pago's network.
